Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to remove a specific element from an array. 
Input Description:
The program should accept an integer N (size of the array).
The next N integers represent the elements of the array.
The next integer is the element to be removed. 
Output Description:
The program should print the array after removing the specified element in a single line.
If the element is not found, print the original array. 
Sample Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5
3 
Sample Output:
1 2 4 5
